mapper.select: SELECT u.id as user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.real_name, u.email, u.phone, u.avatar, u.gender, u.birthday, u.status, u.user_type, u.login_count, u.last_login_time, u.last_login_ip, u.password_update_time, u.remark, u.create_time, u.update_time, u.create_by, u.update_by, u.is_deleted, u.delete_time, ur.role_id, up.post_id, ud.dept_id FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_post up ON u.id = up.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user_dept ud ON u.id = ud.user_id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = 0

SELECT u.id as user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.real_name, u.email, u.phone, u.avatar, u.gender, u.birthday, u.status, u.user_type, u.login_count, u.last_login_time, u.last_login_ip, u.password_update_time, u.remark, u.create_time, u.update_time, u.create_by, u.update_by, u.is_deleted, u.delete_time FROM sys_user u WHERE u.is_deleted = 0
AND u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{username}, '%')
AND u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickname}, '%')
AND u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{phone}, '%')
AND u.status = #{status}
AND u.user_type = #{userType}
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC

SELECT u.id as user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.real_name, u.email, u.phone, u.avatar, u.gender, u.birthday, u.status, u.user_type, u.login_count, u.last_login_time, u.last_login_ip, u.password_update_time, u.remark, u.create_time, u.update_time, u.create_by, u.update_by, u.is_deleted, u.delete_time FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND ur.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY u.create_time DESC

SELECT u.id as user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.real_name, u.email, u.phone, u.avatar, u.gender, u.birthday, u.status, u.user_type, u.login_count, u.last_login_time, u.last_login_ip, u.password_update_time, u.remark, u.create_time, u.update_time, u.create_by, u.update_by, u.is_deleted, u.delete_time FROM sys_user u INNER JOIN sys_user_dept ud ON u.id = ud.user_id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 AND ud.dept_id = #{deptId} ORDER BY u.create_time DESC
